about_the_game:
ForgeRun is a fast-paced co-op arena survival game where blacksmiths become heroes. Battle endless swarms of enemies, gather fallen anvils, and forge powerful weapons and upgrades mid-fight to survive as long as you can.

Every run, you’ll face waves of goblins, pirates, undead, and other twisted foes, each more relentless than the last. Smash through them, collect gold, and use anvils to craft random items that permanently change your build. Stack crazy combinations, unlock new forging powers, and push your luck to see how far you can go.

Key Features

  • Forge on the Field – Pick up anvils during combat to craft random augments, weapons, and abilities on the fly.

  • Co-op Chaos – Team up with friends and forge your own builds together as you fight off massive hordes.

  • Endless Progression – Level up each run, collect rare prismatic augments, and build absurd synergies.

  • Swarm Survival – Battle diverse enemy factions like Goblins, Pirates, and Undead in increasingly chaotic arenas.

  • Gold & Glory – Earn gold from kills to purchase stat upgrades and become the ultimate forge champion.

  • Anvil-Powered Combat – Every run feels unique thanks to random item rolls and upgrade paths tied to your forges.

Will your team stand the test of the horde… or be crushed under your own creations?

content_descriptors.notes:
ForgeRun contains cartoonish fantasy violence and combat against enemy creatures such as goblins, pirates, and undead. Enemies are defeated through stylized attacks, particle effects, and light impact animations.
There are no depictions of realistic gore, sexual content, drug use, or self-harm. The tone is lighthearted and arcade-style, not realistic or graphic.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4,096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Low-poly art style and optimized assets — runs well on most modern laptops and desktops.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8,192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
